title: Visawe (Theme 8: Wanyama wa porini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child tests a synonym by putting it in the sentence in place of the word: the meaning must not change.
representations: a sentence with a gap for either word
steps: Read the word in its sentence.
Think of another word with the same meaning.
Check the meaning is the same.
contexts: a visit to the game park

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "mnene" or "mkubwa" in the sentence and reads it both ways.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kisawe cha "furaha" ni ___." Kwa nini "huzuni" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kisawe ni neno lenye maana sawa. Kinyume cha furaha ni huzuni, si kisawe.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kisawe cha "haraka" ni ___." Kwa nini "harufu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno yanaweza kuanza kwa herufi zilezile na yasiwe na maana sawa. Kisawe cha haraka ni upesi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kisawe cha "tajiri" ni ___." Kwa nini "mfanyabiashara" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kisawe kinaweza kuchukua mahali pa neno bila kubadilisha maana. Tajiri na mkwasi wana maana sawa.

misconceptions.ask: Ukiweka neno hili badala ya "nyumba", sentensi inabaki sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kisawe kinaweza kuchukua nafasi ya neno katika sentensi ileile: nyumba / makazi.
